name: Group
summary: Groups related controls under one semantic boundary.

useWhen: Laying out a row of related controls that wraps to fit, under one name
avoidWhen: Replacing a form fieldset with a legend
Joining Buttons into one attached or vertical strip; use ButtonGroup.
Choices that share a selected value; use CheckboxGroup or RadioGroup.
Moving between controls with the arrow keys; use Toolbar.
